name: Go Golf Go!
source:
Delson Schafer, with his sister Ashley, have entered the Golf God's Game of Champions. If his aim is right, and they win the tournament, they can get the money necessary to help their sick father. 

Along the way he meets an assortment of "magical" players, including one very red dragon - Rombarth - who's returned to the game with a new perspective.

[From [url=https://eyematerror.itch.io/go-golf-go]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
德尔森·谢弗 (Delson Schafer) 和他的妹妹阿什利 (Ashley) 一起参加了高尔夫之神冠军赛。如果他的目标正确，并且他们赢得了比赛，他们就可以获得必要的资金来帮助生病的父亲。

一路上他遇到了各种各样的“神奇”玩家，其中包括一条非常红的龙 - Rombarth - 他以新的视角回到了游戏。

[来自[url=https://eyematerror.itch.io/go-golf-go]Itch.io[/url]]
